llm_proposer.assessment: The outage is most consistent with failure of a WSS input port in the ROADM at S01. S01 is the sole stated common dependency, and the simultaneous multi-service/OCH losses plus loss of input at multiple S01 egress amplifiers indicate that channels are being blocked inside S01 rather than a fault on svc261 itself.

proposals.rationale: A failed WSS input port at roadm.S01 can simultaneously block all channels arriving on the affected degree and therefore explain the broad set of working-path failures and protection switches. The unaffected services imply a port/degree-specific failure rather than total ROADM failure; the main uncertainty is that no direct WSS equipment alarm is shown.

A disconnected common OMS input feeding S01 could also remove all channels on one incoming degree and produce downstream amplifier-input and OCH LOS alarms. It is less likely because the evidence identifies S01 as the common ROADM dependency but does not show a specific input connector or recent maintenance there.

A switch-fabric failure at S01 could interrupt many ODUs at once. However, it would generate ODU-level failures without causing the observed optical OCH LOS and amplifier input LOS, so it is strongly disfavored.
